notice: All records are fully synthetic, assembled from curated word pools by a seeded random generator. Records are era-neutral: academic-year labels order the record but no year carries a real-world event, and rates and distributions are anchored to published national statistics from 2009 to 2025, so a record resembles no single school year. Values are random-rule-generated and not suitable for training ML models.
